description: JavaScript overrides for YUI widgets in SuiteCRM, including functions for closing panels, centering overlays, and deleting table rows, with licensing and attribution comments.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Panel
classes.description: YUI Panel widget extended with custom close configuration.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Overlay
classes.description: YUI Overlay widget extended with custom centering method.

methods.name: center
